Timing conflicts remain conflicts and cannot promote neutral discovery; existing conflict semantics for supported activities are retained.
Explicit closure and confirmed adequate supply over the complete window retain existing closure semantics.
A supported construction activity continues to qualify under existing Prospect and Lead gates.
Endpoint regression checks Signal list and detail, fact version readback, and closure.
limitations: No phase editor or automatic activity renaming was added. A genuinely supported power activity must be evidenced and reconciled before qualification promotion.
Independent review and combined candidate validation remain controller responsibilities.
